issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962. The parent's acceptance demands proof, not convention: `git stash list` and `git reflog` in the shared checkout are unchanged by a build run, asserted by a test.

Write that test. Either shape is acceptable — pick one and document the choice:
- A Rust integration test (tests/) that snapshots `git stash list`, `git reflog`, HEAD, and `git status --porcelain` before and after invoking scripts/build-from-archive.sh, asserting equality. A full release build inside cargo test is heavy under the cgroup limits; if needed, mark the full-build variant #[ignore] with the invocation documented, and keep a non-ignored test that still verifies the snapshot logic against the shared tree via a dry-run/fast mode of the script.
- Or a built-in self-check mode of scripts/build-from-archive.sh that performs the snapshot/compare around a run, wired into an existing test harness.

Acceptance:
- Prove the test can fail: run it once against a mutated copy of the script (in ~/scratch, never in the shared tree) that does `git stash` or `git checkout <sha>`, and record that it failed.
- The test passes against the real script.
- cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test all clean.
issue.title: Add a regression test asserting a build run leaves git stash list and reflog untouched

issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a pinned MSRV verification lane in bead-rs-ci (`cargo +1.85 check --all-targets`) and states drift between the lane's pinned toolchain and the manifest's `rust-version` must be a CI failure, not a doc nit. No open bead covers the lane or the drift check. Work: verify the lane exists in the bead-rs-ci Argo WorkflowTemplate; add a check that fails the run when the lane's pinned toolchain differs from Cargo.toml's rust-version; record the lane in the verification docs so the declared 1.85 floor stays tested rather than honest by luck.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Enforce MSRV-lane toolchain drift between bead-rs-ci and the manifest rust-version (ADR-004)
